help.title: Help & Support
help.q1: Where does RozgarOne get its information?
help.a1: Every notice links to the official website or PDF it came from. Always confirm details there before applying.
help.a2: Save a notice with the bookmark icon. The app reminds you at 9 AM, 3 days and 1 day before its last date.
help.a3: No. Your profile, document locker and applications stay on this phone. AI answers only receive your age, category, qualification and state.
help.a4: Age is counted on the notice's last date and the category relaxation is added. Education is matched against keywords in the notice, so always read the official criteria.
help.q5: I found wrong information. What should I do?
help.a5: Open the notice, go to the More tab and tap Report a problem. Our team reviews every report.
help.reportWrongHint: Open a notice → More → Report a problem

about.title: About RozgarOne
about.body: RozgarOne collects official government job notices, results, admit cards, syllabus and exam dates in one simple app.
about.point1: Every notice links to its official source.

about.point3: Your profile and documents never leave your phone.
